Team —

We're starting to queue offer sends for a handful of roles that need option grants attached. Before we start sending, I want to confirm the upcoming board / 409A windows so we can a) set grant dates and b) avoid any retro corrections if valuation arrives late. Attached: headcount-queue-may.xlsx (draft list of 6 candidates).

Questions:
- When is the next confirmed board packet cutoff and meeting date?
- When should we expect the 409A final deliverable from Compass Advisors?
- Any legal or payroll blackout windows I should avoid for grant dates?

Plan proposal: target grant date in the May board window if available; fallback to a June window if 409A lags. If we do a retroactive grant date, we'll need consistent comms and DocuSign approach — happy to coordinate.

Can @Laura confirm board timing and @Markus/Neha call out legal/payroll constraints?

Thanks,
Evelyn

Confirming Compass Advisors' 409A schedule for Redwood: we are finishing the market analysis this week and expect to deliver the final 409A valuation report on 2026-05-14 by COB ET. That timeline supports a 5/19 grant date tied to the 5/18 board.

Two notes: if there is material new hiring/compaction that changes the headcount materially after we finish benchmarking, we will need a short follow-up (expected turnaround ~3 business days). From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2026 10:30:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Grant lock periods: planning for May/June hires

Evelyn/Laura —

Thanks. A few legal checks before we finalize:
- Blackout/embargo: Payroll will need final ISO grant date and strike price before exercising any payroll withholding. For bookkeeping, we should avoid setting grant dates the same day as payroll close (typically 5/20 for May) to reduce complexity. 5/19 is safer.
- Offer language: please use the attached clause that clarifies grant is subject to board approval and final 409A (we've used this standard clause before). If we issue offers earlier with a placeholder "anticipated grant date" we must include explicit conditional language and an instruction for candidate to acknowledge will be finalized upon valuation.
- Retro grants: legal is okay with retroactive grant dates to the extent that (a) valuation supports it and (b) board minutes reflect approval. We'll need to store board minutes and valuation deliverable in the HR file for audit.

Attaching: offer-template-409a-clause.docx

Markus
General Counsel
Redwood Inference
